_about: Ambient light and fog per place (render/ambient.rs, read by scene.rs lighting()). `default` is the baseline and needs all four keys. An override row, `region.<region id>` (the region of the cell the runner stands in) or `level.<n>` (-1, -2, -3: the sewers, the nether, the Inferno), may carry any of the four; a missing key falls back to `default`. A region row wins over a level row (scene.rs lighting() only looks up the region on level 0, so a region row never overrides a sewer or Inferno level row). Level 0 region rows: hospital cold teal, mall warm and open, office grey blue, mansion dark warm and tight, maze the baseline. ambient_color: "#rrggbb" or [r, g, b] in 0..1. ambient_energy: 0 or more; the shader adds ambient_color x ambient_energy to every lit surface. The sewer rows (-1, -2) are greener, darker and tighter; scene.rs lighting() also leans their ambient_color toward the water tint by sewer_water.json `glow_mix`. Godot's RefLook is #5a3550 at 0.035, which leaves this shader's rooms black, so the port keeps 0.35: change `default.ambient_energy` to 0.035 for Godot's value. fog_color: [r, g, b] in 0..1, also the clear colour. fog_far: metres to full fog on lit surfaces (the world cull in scene.rs follows the current fog_far, 1.6 x of it, kept between 16 and 80 m). blend_seconds: time constant of the ease toward a new place's look when the runner crosses a region border or changes level (0: the look jumps; default 0.5).
